title: Cooking mechanics
description: Adds cooking mechanics, allowing you to collect and process ready-to-eat dishes
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dfab4ee8ff96a3e78e5b54a3d8d145045e707101_0.webp) --- This plugin adds several new features: a custom workbench/plate, a cooking board where you can assemble multiple dishes, dishes that are twice as filling and can be placed anywhere, and a wealth system (villagers highly value these dishes and will reward you with many emeralds). Plugin does not require resource packs. ### ALL THE CRAFTS ARE IN THE GALLERY --- --- For more detailed explanations, provide this link to an AI assistant: `https://github.com/xleb281/CookingMechanicsUpdate/blob/main/README.md` ---

Cook's Spoon

A special cooking tool used to interact with all cooking stations. It allows players to start crafting processes, assemble dishes, and modify prepared food.

Controls:
Used in both cooking stations to trigger crafting, assemble dishes, and modify recipes. Right-click interaction depends on the station you are using.

Cooking Board

Used to create advanced dishes by selecting a base plate and combining ingredients into complex meals.

Controls:
Right-Click (with Spoon) — assemble a dish
Shift + Right-Click (with Spoon) — change dish background style

Tray / Craft Table

A hybrid cooking station that works as both a storage and crafting surface. Players can place items, use them in recipes, and consume food directly from it.

Controls:
Right-Click — place item
Shift + Right-Click — pick up item
Right-Click (with Spoon) — craft recipe

--- ## 🍣 Example Cooking Process **Example: Roll → Final Dish Assembly** - Place dried kelp and raw cod on the Tray / Craft Table - Use the Cook’s Spoon to craft the recipe - Receive a **Roll** as the result - Take several Rolls (for example, 6 pieces) - Place them on the Cooking Board - **Change the dish base to ROLL (mandatory step)** - Use the Cook’s Spoon to assemble the final dish - Receive the completed dish item ## 🍽️ Result usage - Place the dish in the world as a decorative object - Eat it piece by piece using right-click - Sell it to villagers for emeralds ## 📜 Command | Command | Description | Usage | |--------|------------|-------| | `/cooking item ` | Gives a custom item (dishes, special heads) to the player | `/cooking item dish-1/блюдо-1` | | `/cooking language ` | Changes plugin language and reloads messages | `/cooking language ru` | | `/cooking update` | Restarting config reading | `/cooking update` | --- ![title2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d7b598b0015ce3317739dfa6350d9f1e5af592a2.png) Here's what you can cook, and that's not all
